**The Affirmation of the Disciple**

I am a point of light <br>
Within a greater Light.<br>
I am a strand of loving energy <br>
Within the stream of love divine.<br>
I am a point of sacrificial Fire,<br> 
Focused within the fiery Will of God.<br>
And thus, I stand.<br>

I am a way <br>
By which men may achieve.<br>
I am a source of strength, <br>
Enabling them to stand.<br>
I am a beam of light, <br>
Shining upon their way.<br>
And thus, I stand.<br>

And standing thus revolve<br>
And tread this way <br>
The ways of men,<br>
And know the ways of God.<br>
And thus, I stand.<br>

Ancient Mantram of Affirmation. Extracted from the book (published by the Lucis Trust) titled "Discipleship in the New Age", Vol. II, p. 175.Adapted by José Becerra.
